title: 第28章 碧筋蕨
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰的呼吸微微一滞。

    一级灵植，碧筋蕨！

    哪怕只是幼年期，一级灵植的药效也远远强过成年期的血根草和灰伞肺菇。

    更重要的是，面板描述中清清楚楚的写着，这东西有淬炼筋膜的功效！

    对他而言，这正是眼下需要的东西！

    一旦能突破筋膜关，他的实力将迎来又一次暴涨！

    陈峰喉结微动，收好斩刀，朝那片草丛走去。

    夜视仪的画面里，碧筋蕨墨绿色的叶片边缘隐隐流淌着荧光，在周围枯黄的杂草中格外扎眼。

    越走越近，十米，七米，五米，三米……

    就在陈峰即将伸手的刹那，他右手暴起，斩刀出鞘！

    而后腰胯拧转，手中刀锋裹挟着千斤巨力，狠狠朝着右侧的草丛劈落！

    与此同时，身侧不到两米的草丛深处。

    一声尖锐嘶鸣骤然炸响，

    “嘶！”

    随后草丛分开，一颗将近人头大小的蛇头猛然探出，张开血盆大口，粗壮的獠牙狠狠对着陈峰的腰腹咬了过来。

    而此时。

    陈峰神色不变，手中刀锋丝毫不停，悍然落下！

    铛！

    刀锋上裹挟的巨大的冲击力硬生生将那颗蛇头砸偏。

    整个蛇身被劈飞出去，在半空中甩了个弧线，重重砸在三四米外的地面上。

    碎草纷飞，泥土迸溅。

    陈峰后退三步，斩刀横在身前，瞧见了那东西的全貌。

    一条通体暗绿色的巨蟒，粗壮的蛇身足有成年柳树一般粗细，长度目测超过七八米。

    暗绿色的鳞片细密排列，透着一抹如同金属似的质感。

    而蛇头处被陈峰一刀劈出了一道长长的豁口，暗绿色的血液正往外渗。

    视野中浮现出一行文字。

    【腐鳞水蟒】

    【描述：成年异种爬行类，体表分泌腐蚀性黏液，具有极强的绞杀力量和伏击能力。】

    陈峰眯起眼睛。

    果然，他就说不对劲。
content_en:
Chen Feng's breathing stagnated slightly.

    First-level spiritual plant, Bijin Fern!

    Even if it is only in its juvenile stage, the medicinal effect of the first-level spiritual plant is far stronger than that of bloodroot and gray toadstool in its adult stage.

    More importantly, the panel description clearly states that this thing has the effect of tempering fascia!

    For him, this is exactly what is needed right now!

    Once he can break through the fascia barrier, his strength will skyrocket again!

    Chen Feng's Adam's apple moved slightly, he put away his chopping knife and walked towards the grass.

    In the picture of the night vision device, the dark green leaves of the green fern were faintly glowing with fluorescence, which was particularly eye-catching among the surrounding yellow weeds.

    Getting closer and closer, ten meters, seven meters, five meters, three meters...

    Just when Chen Feng was about to stretch out his hand, his right hand shot up and the sword was unsheathed!

    Then he twisted his waist and hips, and with the blade in his hand carrying a huge force, he slashed towards the grass on the right!

    At the same time, less than two meters deep in the grass beside him.

    A sharp scream suddenly exploded,

    "Hiss!"

    Then the grass parted, and a snake head nearly the size of a human head suddenly poked out, opened its bloody mouth, and bit Chen Feng's waist and abdomen with its thick fangs.

    And at this time.

    Chen Feng's expression remained unchanged, the blade in his hand did not stop at all, and he dropped it brazenly!

    clang!

    The huge impact carried by the blade forcefully knocked the snake's head away.

    The entire snake body was slashed and flew out, swinging in an arc in mid-air and hitting the ground three or four meters away.

    Broken grass flew and soil splashed.

    Chen Feng took three steps back, holding his sword in front of him, and saw the whole thing.

    A huge python with a dark green body. The thick snake body is as thick as an adult willow tree, and the length is estimated to be more than seven or eight meters.

    The dark green scales are finely arranged, with a metallic-like texture.

    Chen Feng's knife made a long gash in the snake's head, and dark green blood was seeping out.

    A line of text appeared in the field of vision.

    【Rotten Scale Anaconda】

    [Description: An adult heterogeneous reptile that secretes corrosive mucus on its body surface and has extremely strong strangulation power and ambush capabilities. 】

    Chen Feng narrowed his eyes.

    Sure enough, he said something was wrong.
